chunks: And who is better in religion than one who submits his face to Allah, while he is a doer of good, and follows the creed of Abraham the upright? And God chose Abraham as friend.
ai.seo_question: What are the three key characteristics of the best religion according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to define the perfection of religion through the integration of outward submission (Islam) and inward spiritual excellence (Ihsan), mirroring the pure monotheism of Ibrahim. The mention of Ibrahim being taken as a 'Khalil' (intimate friend) of God underscores the high spiritual station of the Ahl al-Bayt, who are seen as the true inheritors of this Hanif tradition. This establishes a theological link between prophetic lineage and the ideal state of the believer.
